prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Antimony (Sb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows.
Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a mechanic's coverall with its top half peeled down and the sleeves tied at the waist over a fitted cropped tank top, work boots — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on the table, her elbow on the table.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks out of the window.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — antimony: a brittle, bluish-silver metalloid whose grey sulfide ore, stibnite, grows in long metallic needles and was ground five thousand years ago into black kohl to line the eyes, its Latin name stibium giving the symbol Sb; alchemists called molten stibnite the grey wolf of metals because it devoured every base metal mixed into gold and left only the pure gold behind; it expands as it freezes, sharpening the letters of cast type, and cooling ingots bloom with fern-like star patterns — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
